sanskrit: mahāmeghanivāsī ca mahāghoro vaśīkaraḥ agnijvālo mahājvālo atidhūmro huto haviḥ
english: He who dwells in the great cloud, the awesome one, the subduer; flame of fire, mighty blaze, the deeply smoke-hued, the oblation offered and the offering itself.

sanskrit: vṛṣaṇaḥ śaṃkaro nityo varcasvī dhūmaketanaḥ nīlas tathāṅgalubdhaś ca śobhano niravagrahaḥ
english: The virile one, Śaṃkara the bestower of peace, the eternal, the radiant, he whose banner is smoke; the dark-blue one, eager in his limbs, the resplendent, the unrestrained.

sanskrit: svastidaḥ svastibhāvaś ca bhāgī bhāgakaro laghuḥ utsaṅgaś ca mahāṅgaś ca mahāgarbhaḥ paro yuvā
english: Giver of blessing and the very state of blessing; the partaker, the apportioner, the swift; the embrace, the great-limbed, of mighty womb, supreme, ever young.

sanskrit: kṛṣṇavarṇaḥ suvarṇaś ca indriyaḥ sarvadehinām mahāpādo mahāhasto mahākāyo mahāyaśāḥ
english: Of dark hue and of golden hue, he who is the senses of all embodied beings; great of foot, great of hand, of mighty frame, of vast renown.

sanskrit: mahāmūrdhā mahāmātro mahānetro digālayaḥ mahādanto mahākarṇo mahāmeḍhro mahāhanuḥ
english: Great of head, of great measure, great of eye, whose dwelling is the quarters of space; great of tooth, great of ear, mightily endowed, great of jaw.

sanskrit: mahānāso mahākambur mahāgrīvaḥ śmaśānadhṛk mahāvakṣā mahorasko antarātmā mṛgālayaḥ
english: Great of nose, great-throated as a conch, great of neck, haunter of the cremation-ground; broad of chest, mighty-breasted, the inmost Self, whose abode is among the deer.

sanskrit: lambano lambitoṣṭhaś ca mahāmāyaḥ payonidhiḥ mahādanto mahādaṃṣṭro mahājihvo mahāmukhaḥ
english: The pendant one, with hanging lip, master of great illusion, the ocean of waters; great of tooth, great of fang, great of tongue, great of mouth.

sanskrit: mahānakho mahāromā mahākeśo mahājaṭaḥ asapatnaḥ prasādaś ca pratyayo girisādhanaḥ
english: Great of nail, great of hair, of great locks, with mighty matted braids; without a rival, the gracious one, the ground of all conviction, accomplished upon the mountain.

sanskrit: snehano 'snehanaś caiva ajitaś ca mahāmuniḥ vṛkṣākāro vṛkṣaketur analo vāyuvāhanaḥ
english: He who shows tenderness and he who is without attachment, the unconquered, the great sage; in form like a tree, whose emblem is the tree, the fire, borne upon the wind.

sanskrit: maṇḍalī merudhāmā ca devadānavadarpahā atharvaśīrṣaḥ sāmāsya ṛksahasrāmitekṣaṇaḥ
english: The ringed one, whose seat is Meru, breaker of the pride of gods and Dānavas; he whose head is the Atharva, whose face is the Sāman, whose unbounded gaze is the thousand verses of the Ṛk.

sanskrit: yajuḥpādabhujo guhyaḥ prakāśo jaṅgamas tathā amoghārthaḥ prasādaś ca abhigamyaḥ sudarśanaḥ
english: He whose feet and arms are the Yajus, the hidden one, the manifest, and likewise the moving; of unfailing purpose, the gracious, the approachable, fair to behold.

sanskrit: upahārapriyaḥ śarvaḥ kanakaḥ kāñcanaḥ sthiraḥ nābhir nandikaro bhāvyaḥ puṣkarasthapatiḥ sthiraḥ
english: Lover of offerings, Śarva, the golden, the gold-bright, the steadfast; the navel, maker of joy, he who is to be meditated upon, lord enthroned upon the lotus, the unmoving.

sanskrit: dvādaśas trāsanaś cādyo yajño yajñasamāhitaḥ naktaṃ kaliś ca kālaś ca makaraḥ kālapūjitaḥ
english: The twelvefold, the terrifier, the primal; the sacrifice and he who is composed within the sacrifice; the night, the age of strife, and Time itself, the sea-monster, worshipped through all time.

sanskrit: sagaṇo gaṇakāraś ca bhūtabhāvanasārathiḥ bhasmaśāyī bhasmagoptā bhasmabhūtas tarur gaṇaḥ
english: He who is with his hosts and maker of hosts, the charioteer who fosters all beings; couched upon ashes, guardian of ashes, become as ash, the tree, the troop.

sanskrit: agaṇaś caiva lopaś ca mahātmā sarvapūjitaḥ śaṅkus triśaṅkuḥ saṃpannaḥ śucir bhūtaniṣevitaḥ
english: He without host, and the dissolution, the great-souled, worshipped by all; the stake, the triple-staked, the perfected, the pure, attended by the spirits.

sanskrit: āśramasthaḥ kapotastho viśvakarmā patir varaḥ śākho viśākhas tāmroṣṭho hy ambujālaḥ suniścayaḥ
english: Abiding in the hermitage, seated as a dove, maker of the universe, the choicest lord; the Branch and Viśākha, copper-lipped, a net of lotuses, the firmly resolved.

sanskrit: kapilo 'kapilaḥ śūra āyuś caiva paro 'paraḥ gandharvo hy aditis tārkṣyaḥ suvijñeyaḥ susārathiḥ
english: The tawny and the non-tawny, the hero, and life itself, the higher and the lower; the Gandharva, indeed Aditi, Tārkṣya, the easily known, the skilled charioteer.

sanskrit: paraśvadhāyudho deva arthakārī subāndhavaḥ tumbavīṇī mahākopa ūrdhvaretā jaleśayaḥ
english: He whose weapon is the battle-axe, the god, doer of all purpose, the good kinsman; bearer of the gourd-lute, of mighty wrath, of upward-drawn seed, who couches upon the waters.

sanskrit: ugro vaṃśakaro vaṃśo vaṃśanādo hy aninditaḥ sarvāṅgarūpo māyāvī suhṛdo hy anilo 'nalaḥ
english: The fierce, the maker of lineage, the lineage, the sound of the flute, the blameless; whose form is in every limb, the wielder of illusion, the true friend, the wind and the fire.

sanskrit: bandhano bandhakartā ca subandhanavimocanaḥ sa yajñāriḥ sa kāmārir mahādaṃṣṭro mahāyudhaḥ
english: The binder and maker of bonds, and the loosener of the close-drawn fetter; he is the foe of the sacrifice, he the foe of desire, great of fang, mighty in arms.

sanskrit: bāhus tv aninditaḥ śarvaḥ śaṃkaraḥ śaṃkaro 'dhanaḥ amareśo mahādevo viśvadevaḥ surārihā
english: The arm indeed, the blameless, Śarva, Śaṃkara, the bestower of peace who is without possession; lord of the immortals, the Great God, the All-god, slayer of the foes of the gods.

sanskrit: ahirbudhno nirṛtiś ca cekitāno haris tathā ajaikapāc ca kāpālī triśaṅkur ajitaḥ śivaḥ
english: Ahirbudhnya and Nirṛti, Cekitāna, and likewise Hari; Ajaikapād and the bearer of the skull, the triple-staked, the unconquered, the auspicious one, Śiva.

sanskrit: dhanvantarir dhūmaketuḥ skando vaiśravaṇas tathā dhātā śakraś ca viṣṇuś ca mitras tvaṣṭā dhruvo dharaḥ
english: Dhanvantari, he whose banner is smoke, Skanda, and likewise Vaiśravaṇa; Dhātṛ and Śakra and Viṣṇu, Mitra, Tvaṣṭṛ, Dhruva, the upholder.

sanskrit: prabhāvaḥ sarvago vāyur aryamā savitā raviḥ udagraś ca vidhātā ca māndhātā bhūtabhāvanaḥ
english: The source of power, the all-pervading, the wind, Aryaman, Savitṛ, the sun; the lofty, and Vidhātṛ, Māndhātṛ, the fosterer of beings.

sanskrit: ratitīrthaś ca vāgmī ca sarvakāmaguṇāvahaḥ padmagarbho mahāgarbhaś candravaktro manoramaḥ
english: The sacred ford of delight and the eloquent, bearer of every desire and quality; lotus-wombed, of mighty womb, moon-faced, the ravisher of the mind.

sanskrit: balavāṃś copaśāntaś ca purāṇaḥ puṇyacañcurī kurukartā kālarūpī kurubhūto maheśvaraḥ
english: The mighty and the wholly tranquil, the ancient, skilled in what is meritorious; doer of deeds, whose form is Time, become the Kurus, the Great Lord, Maheśvara.

sanskrit: sarvāśayo darbhaśāyī sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ patiḥ devadevamukho 'saktaḥ sad asat sarvaratnavit
english: The refuge of all, who couches upon darbha grass, lord of all that breathes; foremost among god of gods, the unattached, the existent and the non-existent, knower of every jewel.

sanskrit: kailāsaśikharāvāsī himavadgirisaṃśrayaḥ kūlahārī kūlakartā bahuvidyo bahupradaḥ
english: Dweller on the peak of Kailāsa, who has his refuge on the Himavat mountain; sweeper-away of banks and maker of banks, of manifold lore, giver of much.

sanskrit: vaṇijo vardhano vṛkṣo nakulaś candanaś chadaḥ sāragrīvo mahājatrur alolaś ca mahauṣadhaḥ
english: The merchant, the increaser, the tree, the mongoose, the sandal, the leaf-shelter; firm of neck, of mighty collarbone, the unwavering, and the great healing herb.

sanskrit: siddhārthakārī siddhārthaś chandovyākaraṇottaraḥ siṃhanādaḥ siṃhadaṃṣṭraḥ siṃhagaḥ siṃhavāhanaḥ
english: Accomplisher of true ends and the one whose end is accomplished, supreme in metre and grammar; the lion's roar, lion-fanged, lion-gaited, lion-borne.

sanskrit: prabhāvātmā jagatkālas tālo lokahitas taruḥ sāraṅgo navacakrāṅgaḥ ketumālī sabhāvanaḥ
english: His own self the source of power, the Time of the world, the rhythm, the good of the worlds, the tree; the dappled one, whose body is the nine wheels, garlanded with banners, the well-disposed.

sanskrit: bhūtālayo bhūtapatir ahorātram aninditaḥ vāhitā sarvabhūtānāṃ nilayaś ca vibhur bhavaḥ
english: The dwelling of beings, lord of beings, blameless as day and night; the bearer of all beings, their resting-place, the all-pervading, the existent, Bhava.

sanskrit: amoghaḥ saṃyato hy aśvo bhojanaḥ prāṇadhāraṇaḥ dhṛtimān matimān dakṣaḥ satkṛtaś ca yugādhipaḥ
english: The unerring, the restrained, indeed the horse, the sustenance, the upholder of life-breath; steadfast, wise, skilful, honoured, lord of the aeons.

sanskrit: gopālir gopatir grāmo gocarmavasano haraḥ hiraṇyabāhuś ca tathā guhāpālaḥ praveśinām
english: The herder, lord of cattle, the village, clad in a hide of leather, Hara; golden-armed, and likewise the guardian of the cave for those who enter.

sanskrit: pratiṣṭhāyī mahāharṣo jitakāmo jitendriyaḥ gandhāraś ca surālaś ca tapaḥkarmaratir dhanuḥ
english: The well-established, of great joy, conqueror of desire, conqueror of the senses; Gandhāra and Surāla, who delights in the works of austerity, the bow.

sanskrit: mahāgīto mahānṛtto hy apsarogaṇasevitaḥ mahāketur dhanur dhātur naikasānucaraś calaḥ
english: Of great song, of mighty dance, attended by the hosts of Apsarases; the great-bannered, the bow, the upholder, follower of many ridges, the ever-moving.

sanskrit: āvedanīya āveśaḥ sarvagandhasukhāvahaḥ toraṇas tāraṇo vāyuḥ paridhāvati caikataḥ
english: He to whom all is to be made known, the indwelling presence, bearer of every fragrance and joy; the gateway, the deliverer, the wind, who courses about from one place alone.

sanskrit: saṃyogo vardhano vṛddho mahāvṛddho gaṇādhipaḥ nitya ātmasahāyaś ca devāsurapatiḥ patiḥ
english: The union, the increaser, the aged, the mightily aged, lord of the hosts; the eternal, his own self his only helper, lord of gods and Asuras, the master.

sanskrit: yuktaś ca yuktabāhuś ca dvividhaś ca suparvaṇaḥ āṣāḍhaś ca suṣāḍhaś ca dhruvo harihaṇo haraḥ
english: The yoked and the strong-armed, the twofold and the well-jointed; Āṣāḍha and Suṣāḍha, the fixed one, slayer of Hari's foes, Hara.

sanskrit: vapur āvartamānebhyo vasuśreṣṭho mahāpathaḥ śirohārī vimarṣaś ca sarvalakṣaṇabhūṣitaḥ
english: The body for those caught in the turning round of birth, best of the Vasus, the great path; bearer of heads, the deliberating one, adorned with every auspicious mark.

sanskrit: akṣaś ca rathayogī ca sarvayogī mahābalaḥ samāmnāyo 'samāmnāyas tīrthadevo mahārathaḥ
english: The axle and he yoked to the chariot, the master of all yoga, of mighty strength; the sacred tradition and what lies beyond tradition, god of the holy fords, the great charioteer.

sanskrit: nirjīvo jīvano mantraḥ śubhākṣo bahukarkaśaḥ ratnaprabhūto raktāṅgo mahārṇavanipānavit
english: The lifeless and the life-giving, the sacred word, fair of eye, of many a rough place; rich in jewels, red of limb, who knows the drinking-down of the great ocean.

sanskrit: mūlo viśālo hy amṛto vyaktāvyaktas taponidhiḥ ārohaṇo nirohaś ca śailahārī mahātapāḥ
english: The root, the vast, indeed the immortal, the manifest and unmanifest, the treasury of austerity; the ascent and the descent, sweeper-away of mountains, of mighty penance.

sanskrit: senākalpo mahākalpo yugāyugakaro hariḥ yugarūpo mahārūpaḥ pavano gahano nagaḥ
english: Marshalled like an army, the great cosmic age, maker of age upon age, Hari; whose form is the aeon, of mighty form, the purifier, the unfathomable, the mountain.

sanskrit: nyāyanirvāpaṇaḥ pādaḥ paṇḍito hy acalopamaḥ bahumālo mahāmālaḥ sumālo bahulocanaḥ
english: He who quenches all by right reasoning, the foot, the learned, indeed like the unmoving mountain; many-garlanded, of great garland, of fair garland, of many eyes.

sanskrit: vistāro lavaṇaḥ kūpaḥ kusumaḥ saphalodayaḥ vṛṣabho vṛṣabhāṅkāṅgo maṇibilvo jaṭādharaḥ
english: The expanse, the salt, the well, the blossom, whose rising bears fruit; the bull, whose limb is marked with the bull, the bearer of jewel and bilva, wearer of matted locks.

sanskrit: indur visargaḥ sumukhaḥ suraḥ sarvāyudhaḥ sahaḥ nivedanaḥ sudhājātaḥ sugandhāro mahādhanuḥ
english: The moon, the emanation, fair of face, the god, armed with every weapon, the forbearing; the surrender, born of nectar, of sweet fragrance, the great bow.

sanskrit: gandhamālī ca bhagavān utthānaḥ sarvakarmaṇām manthāno bahulo bāhuḥ sakalaḥ sarvalocanaḥ
english: Garlanded with fragrance, the Blessed One, the rousing of all works; the churner, the abundant, the arm, the whole, the all-seeing.

sanskrit: tarastālī karastālī ūrdhvasaṃhanano vahaḥ chatraṃ succhatro vikhyātaḥ sarvalokāśrayo mahān
english: He who beats time swiftly, who beats time with his hand, of upward-knit frame, the bearing one; the parasol, the well-sheltering, the renowned, the refuge of all worlds, the great.

sanskrit: muṇḍo virūpo vikṛto daṇḍimuṇḍo vikurvaṇaḥ haryakṣaḥ kakubho vajrī dīptajihvaḥ sahasrapāt
english: The shaven-headed, the formless, the misshapen, the staff-bearing and bald, the transforming one; tawny-eyed, the eminence, the wielder of the thunderbolt, of blazing tongue, thousand-footed.

sanskrit: sahasramūrdhā devendraḥ sarvadevamayo guruḥ sahasrabāhuḥ sarvāṅgaḥ śaraṇyaḥ sarvalokakṛt
english: Thousand-headed, lord of the gods, made of all gods, the teacher; thousand-armed, present in every limb, the refuge-giving, maker of all worlds.

sanskrit: pavitraṃ trimadhur mantraḥ kaniṣṭhaḥ kṛṣṇapiṅgalaḥ brahmadaṇḍavinirmātā śataghnī śatapāśadhṛk
english: The pure, the threefold sweetness, the sacred word, the youngest, the dark and tawny; fashioner of the staff of Brahman, the hundred-slayer, holder of a hundred nooses.

sanskrit: padmagarbho mahāgarbho brahmagarbho jalodbhavaḥ gabhastir brahmakṛd brahmā brahmavid brāhmaṇo gatiḥ
english: Lotus-wombed, of mighty womb, womb of the Brahman, sprung from the waters; the ray of light, maker of the sacred word, Brahmā, knower of the Brahman, the Brāhmaṇa, the goal.

sanskrit: anantarūpo naikātmā tigmatejāḥ svayaṃbhuvaḥ ūrdhvagātmā paśupatir vātaraṃhā manojavaḥ
english: Of endless forms, not of a single self, of keen splendour, the self-existent; whose self moves ever upward, lord of cattle, swift as the wind, fleet as thought.

sanskrit: candanī padmamālāgryaḥ surabhyuttaraṇo naraḥ karṇikāramahāsragvī nīlamauliḥ pinākadhṛk
english: Sandal-anointed, foremost in his garland of lotuses, who delivers across by fragrance, the Man; great-wreathed with karṇikāra blossoms, blue-crested, bearer of the Pināka bow.

sanskrit: umāpatir umākānto jāhnavīdhṛg umādhavaḥ varo varāho varado vareśaḥ sumahāsvanaḥ
english: Lord of Umā, beloved of Umā, who upholds the Jāhnavī, consort of Umā; the boon, the boar, the giver of boons, lord of boons, of mighty resounding voice.

sanskrit: mahāprasādo damanaḥ śatruhā śvetapiṅgalaḥ prītātmā prayatātmā ca saṃyatātmā pradhānadhṛk
english: Of great grace, the subduer, slayer of foes, white and tawny; glad of soul, of disciplined soul, of restrained soul, upholder of primal nature.

sanskrit: sarvapārśvasutas tārkṣyo dharmasādhāraṇo varaḥ carācarātmā sūkṣmātmā suvṛṣo govṛṣeśvaraḥ
english: Born at every side, Tārkṣya, the common ground of dharma, the choicest; the self of all that moves and is still, of subtle soul, the good bull, lord of the cattle-bull.

sanskrit: sādhyarṣir vasur ādityo vivasvān savitā mṛḍaḥ vyāsaḥ sarvasya saṃkṣepo vistaraḥ paryayo nayaḥ
english: Seer of the Sādhyas, the Vasu, the Āditya, Vivasvān, Savitṛ, the gracious; Vyāsa, the gathering-together of all, the expanse, the turning round, the guiding course.

sanskrit: ṛtuḥ saṃvatsaro māsaḥ pakṣaḥ saṃkhyāsamāpanaḥ kalā kāṣṭhā lavo mātrā muhūrto 'haḥ kṣapāḥ kṣaṇāḥ
english: The season, the year, the month, the fortnight, the completion of reckoning; the moment-fraction, the instant, the particle, the measure, the muhūrta, the day, the nights, the breaths of time.

sanskrit: viśvakṣetraṃ prajābījaṃ liṅgam ādyas tv aninditaḥ sad asad vyaktam avyaktaṃ pitā mātā pitāmahaḥ
english: The field of the universe, the seed of all creatures, the sign, the primal, indeed the blameless; the existent and the non-existent, the manifest and the unmanifest, father, mother, grandsire.

sanskrit: svargadvāraṃ prajādvāraṃ mokṣadvāraṃ triviṣṭapam nirvāṇaṃ hlādanaṃ caiva brahmalokaḥ parā gatiḥ
english: The gate of heaven, the gate of creatures, the gate of release, the triple heaven; extinction and gladdening too, the world of Brahman, the supreme goal.

sanskrit: devāsuravinirmātā devāsuraparāyaṇaḥ devāsuragurur devo devāsuranamaskṛtaḥ
english: Fashioner of gods and Asuras, the refuge of gods and Asuras; teacher of gods and Asuras, the god, saluted by gods and Asuras.

sanskrit: devāsuramahāmātro devāsuragaṇāśrayaḥ devāsuragaṇādhyakṣo devāsuragaṇāgraṇīḥ
english: The chief minister of gods and Asuras, the resort of the hosts of gods and Asuras; overseer of the hosts of gods and Asuras, foremost leader of the hosts of gods and Asuras.

sanskrit: devātidevo devarṣir devāsuravarapradaḥ devāsureśvaro devo devāsuramaheśvaraḥ
english: The god beyond the gods, the divine seer, giver of boons to gods and Asuras; lord of gods and Asuras, the god, the Great Lord of gods and Asuras.

sanskrit: sarvadevamayo 'cintyo devatātmātmasaṃbhavaḥ udbhidas trikramo vaidyo virajo virajombaraḥ
english: Made of all gods, the inconceivable, whose self is the deities, self-arisen; the sprouting forth, the thrice-striding, the healer, the stainless, clad in stainless raiment.

sanskrit: īḍyo hastī suravyāghro devasiṃho nararṣabhaḥ vibudhāgravaraḥ śreṣṭhaḥ sarvadevottamottamaḥ
english: The praiseworthy, the elephant, the tiger among gods, the lion among gods, the bull among men; foremost and choicest of the wise, the best, the highest of the high among all gods.

sanskrit: prayuktaḥ śobhano vajra īśānaḥ prabhur avyayaḥ guruḥ kānto nijaḥ sargaḥ pavitraḥ sarvavāhanaḥ
english: The well-applied, the resplendent, the thunderbolt, Īśāna the ruler, the lord, the imperishable; the teacher, the beloved, the innate, the creation, the pure, who bears all upon him.

sanskrit: śṛṅgī śṛṅgapriyo babhrū rājarājo nirāmayaḥ abhirāmaḥ suragaṇo virāmaḥ sarvasādhanaḥ
english: The horned, lover of the peak, the tawny, king of kings, the unailing; the delightful, the host of gods, the ceasing, the means of all attainment.

sanskrit: lalāṭākṣo viśvadeho hariṇo brahmavarcasaḥ sthāvarāṇāṃ patiś caiva niyamendriyavardhanaḥ
english: Eyed upon the brow, his body the universe, the fawn-hued, possessed of the lustre of the Brahman; and lord too of all things unmoving, increaser of restraint and the senses.

sanskrit: siddhārthaḥ sarvabhūtārtho 'cintyaḥ satyavrataḥ śuciḥ vratādhipaḥ paraṃ brahma muktānāṃ paramā gatiḥ
english: He whose aim is accomplished, the welfare of all beings, the inconceivable, true to his vow, the pure; lord of vows, the supreme Brahman, the highest goal of the liberated.

sanskrit: vimukto muktatejāś ca śrīmāñ śrīvardhano jagat yathāpradhānaṃ bhagavān iti bhaktyā stuto mayā
english: The wholly released, of unfettered splendour, the glorious, the increaser of glory, the world itself: thus, as each was foremost, has the Blessed One been hymned by me in devotion.

sanskrit: yaṃ na brahmādayo devā vidur yaṃ na maharṣayaḥ taṃ stavyam arcyaṃ vandyaṃ ca kaḥ stoṣyati jagatpatim
english: Him whom the gods, with Brahmā at their head, do not know, whom the great seers do not know, that one worthy to be praised, worshipped, and revered, the Lord of the world — who shall hymn him?

sanskrit: bhaktim eva puraskṛtya mayā yajñapatir vasuḥ tato 'bhyanujñāṃ prāpyaiva stuto matimatāṃ varaḥ
english: Setting devotion alone before me, having first obtained his leave, I have hymned the lord of sacrifice, the Vasu, the best of the wise.

sanskrit: śivam ebhiḥ stuvan devaṃ nāmabhiḥ puṣṭivardhanaiḥ nityayuktaḥ śucir bhūtvā prāpnoty ātmānam ātmanā
english: He who praises Śiva the god with these names that increase well-being, ever steadfast and grown pure, attains the Self by the self.

sanskrit: etad dhi paramaṃ brahma svayaṃ gītaṃ svayaṃbhuvā ṛṣayaś caiva devāś ca stuvanty etena tatparam
english: For this is the supreme Brahman, sung by the Self-existent himself; and with it the seers and the gods praise that which is beyond.

sanskrit: stūyamāno mahādevaḥ prīyate cātmanāmabhiḥ bhaktānukampī bhagavān ātmasaṃsthān karoti tān
english: The Great God, when praised, is gladdened by the names of his own self; the Blessed One, compassionate to his devotees, establishes them within himself.

sanskrit: tathaiva ca manuṣyeṣu ye manuṣyāḥ pradhānataḥ āstikāḥ śraddadhānāś ca bahubhir janmabhiḥ stavaiḥ
english: And likewise among men, those who are foremost among men, the faithful and the believing, through many births and many hymns of praise,

sanskrit: jāgrataś ca svapantaś ca vrajantaḥ pathi saṃsthitāḥ stuvanti stūyamānāś ca tuṣyanti ca ramanti ca janmakoṭisahasreṣu nānāsaṃsārayoniṣu
english: waking and sleeping, walking or halted upon the road, they praise him and are themselves extolled, and they are content and rejoice, through thousands of millions of births in the manifold wombs of transmigration.

sanskrit: jantor viśuddhapāpasya bhave bhaktiḥ prajāyate utpannā ca bhave bhaktir ananyā sarvabhāvataḥ
english: In the creature whose sin is wholly cleansed there is born devotion to Bhava; and once arisen, devotion to Bhava becomes undivided, with the whole of one's being.
